column1: # ONE PLANT x FUEL x YEAR RECONCILIATION OF THE COAL FLEET (T-ENERGY-2 item 2).
# Read-and-tabulate: nothing here is booked and no shipped product is touched.
# QUANTITY CLASS. NEPRA's printed column is 'Quantity of Coal used (000 M. Tons)' inside a
# table titled 'Fuel Consumption and Cost of Generation Data of IPPs (Net)'. That is coal
# change. The national lane it is compared against (HDIP via Statistical Supplement Table
# 14.1(4)) is the opposite: APPARENT consumption constructed from supply
# carry a stock change by construction. See implied_efficiency_decomposition.csv.
# GENERATION BASIS. Every generation figure here is NET
# table prints two bases - 'On Gross Generation' and 'On Net Export to NTDC' - and the
# energy columns below are given on BOTH rather than mixed.
# fiscal_start_year_key is the ledger's own key: 2019 == FY2019-20. A known trap.
# Rows are per plant-year; a row is never additive with another row's derived column.
